general.title: Program execution & state
general.summary: A language-neutral checklist for understanding what a program does before translating it to syntax.

entries.meaning: Trace where data comes from, how it changes, and which side effects it causes.
entries.detail: Given input → validated value → result / failure

entries.meaning: Distinguish a value from the identity of the object storing it.
entries.detail: Does an update mutate shared state or create a new value?

entries.meaning: Account for all branches, loops, early exits, and exceptional paths.
State what must remain true before and after an operation.
Treat external input as untrusted and keep side effects at explicit edges.

more.meaning: Describe what callers must supply and what success guarantees.
more.detail: Pre: valid account · Post: transfer recorded exactly once

general.title: Data structures & complexity
general.summary: Choose structures by operations and constraints, not by language-specific class names.

entries.meaning: Preserves element order; indexing and mutation costs depend on its implementation.
Represents unique members, typically optimized for membership tests.
Associates keys with values; lookup complexity depends on implementation.
Separate the number of operations from the input size.
entries.detail: Linear scan O(n) · nested scans O(n²)

entries.meaning: Count temporary allocations and retained data.
entries.detail: Streaming uses less memory than materializing everything

more.meaning: Set and map correctness depends on consistent equality/hash behavior.
more.detail: Equal keys must have equal hashes

general.title: Functions, APIs & error contracts
general.summary: Define observable behavior independently of Python exceptions or .NET types.

entries.meaning: Specify inputs, result shape and failure modes.
entries.detail: Valid response · invalid input · missing resource

entries.meaning: Same inputs yield same result without externally observable side effects.
Repeating the operation has the same intended effect as doing it once.
entries.detail: Set state to enabled (vs increment counter)

entries.meaning: Distinguish expected domain outcomes from infrastructure errors.
entries.detail: Not found vs timeout vs malformed payload

entries.meaning: Consider versioning and existing callers before changing a public interface.
entries.detail: Adding an optional field vs renaming a required field

more.meaning: Prefer testing outcomes and externally visible events over private implementation details.
more.detail: Assert persisted value and returned status

general.title: Concurrency & resource ownership
general.summary: Shared concepts apply across languages, but runtime scheduling and syntax differ.

entries.meaning: Overlapping operations are not necessarily executed simultaneously.
entries.detail: Async I/O vs CPU work on multiple cores

entries.meaning: A caller should be able to stop abandoned work safely.
Put an upper bound on waits, retries and requests.
entries.detail: Deadline per workflow; bounded retry budget

entries.meaning: Unsynchronized access makes a result depend on execution timing.
entries.detail: Two writers updating the same state

entries.meaning: Acquire and release files, sockets and locks predictably.
entries.detail: Dispose/close even when an operation fails

more.meaning: Retry only when operation semantics permit; use backoff and idempotency.
more.detail: Do not blindly retry an unprotected payment

general.title: Testability & debugging
general.summary: The testing method is general; assertion libraries and mocking syntax are not.

entries.meaning: Set up state, execute behavior, check a meaningful outcome.
Cover zero, one, minimum, maximum, null/missing and invalid values.
entries.detail: Empty list · 1 item · very large list

entries.meaning: Control time, randomness, network and external state.
entries.detail: Inject clock / fixed seed / fake dependency

entries.meaning: Avoid cross-test order dependence and leaked global state.
entries.detail: Fresh fixture or clean storage per test

entries.meaning: Capture reproducible inputs and diagnostic context.
entries.detail: Correlation ID, request ID, expected vs actual

more.meaning: Add a focused test for the failure and nearby edge cases.

general.title: Maintainable program design
general.summary: Keep boundaries, names and responsibilities clear before choosing language-specific constructs.

entries.meaning: Keep related behavior together without mixing unrelated concerns.
entries.detail: Parsing, business rules and storage in separate units

entries.meaning: Higher-level logic should depend on stable contracts, not incidental details.
Make it clear who creates, changes and disposes a resource.
entries.detail: A single owner closes the open connection

entries.meaning: Group operations that act on the same concept.
entries.detail: User validation rules in one component

entries.meaning: Prefer the least complex design meeting actual needs.
entries.detail: Do not introduce abstractions without repeated use

csharp.title: Syntax & control flow
csharp.summary: C# blocks, declarations and branch/loop forms.

entries.meaning: var is statically inferred, not dynamically typed.
Use braces around controlled statements for clarity.
Choose a result by matching a value.
Enumerate without manual indexes.
Check a type or pattern while introducing a variable.

more.meaning: Provide a value when an expression is null.
Embed expressions with $-prefixed strings.

csharp.title: Types & null safety
csharp.summary: Distinguish compile-time types, nullable annotations, and value/reference semantics.

entries.meaning: An assignment copies the value for structs and built-in numeric types.
Assignment copies a reference, not the referenced instance.
Allow absence for non-nullable value types.
Nullable context enables compile-time diagnostics; not a runtime guard.
Return null if the receiver is null.

more.meaning: Evaluate the right side only if the left is null.
Prefer pattern checks when types are uncertain.

csharp.title: Strings, numbers & formatting
csharp.summary: Practical C# string handling and numeric conversions.

entries.meaning: Create formatted output.
Transform delimited text.
Choose explicit comparison semantics.
Avoid exceptions for routine invalid input.
Use decimal rather than binary floating point for decimal money amounts.

more.meaning: Remove outer whitespace.
Use a fixed culture for machine-readable text.

csharp.title: Methods & parameter passing
csharp.summary: C# overloads and parameter passing are different from Python argument semantics.

entries.meaning: Declare return and parameter types.
entries.detail: static int Sum(int a, int b) => a + b;

entries.meaning: Default supplied when argument omitted.
entries.detail: static int Total(int value, int tax = 0) => value + tax;

entries.meaning: Make call-site meaning explicit.
Pass a caller's initialized variable by reference.
Called method must assign an output value.

more.meaning: Readonly-byref parameter; often used for large structs.
more.detail: void Print(in LargeStruct value) { /* read only */ }

more.meaning: Differentiate methods by parameter signature, not return type alone.

csharp.title: Classes & properties
csharp.summary: Encapsulation through class members, properties and access modifiers.

entries.meaning: Declare a reference type.
Establish initial state.
Expose controlled state.
entries.detail: public string Name { get; private set; }

entries.meaning: Derive a read-only computed value.
Belongs to the type, not each instance.
entries.detail: public static int Count { get; private set; }

more.meaning: Access is limited to the same assembly.
Set a property during object initialization.

csharp.title: Inheritance, interfaces & polymorphism
csharp.summary: Model contracts and dispatch without conflating interfaces, virtual methods and composition.

entries.meaning: Describe required members.
Supply all required interface members.
entries.detail: class FileReader : IReader { public string Read() => "data"; }

entries.meaning: Enable and implement runtime polymorphism.
entries.detail: public virtual void Run() {} · public override void Run() {}

entries.meaning: Share base implementation but block direct instantiation.
entries.detail: abstract class Worker { public abstract void Run(); }

entries.meaning: Prevent further inheritance or overriding as appropriate.

more.meaning: Prefer combining collaborators when inheritance is not the natural relationship.

csharp.title: Records, structs & equality
csharp.summary: Data-oriented types have different assignment and equality defaults.

entries.meaning: Reference record with value-based equality by default.
entries.detail: public record Person(string Name, int Age);

entries.meaning: Value type with generated value equality.
entries.detail: public readonly record struct Point(int X, int Y);

entries.meaning: A value type copied by assignment.
entries.detail: public readonly struct Token { public int Id { get; init; } }

entries.meaning: Create a copy with selected updated members for supported record types.
Regular classes default to reference equality unless overridden.

more.meaning: Wrap a non-nullable struct in Nullable<T>.

csharp.title: Collections & generics
csharp.summary: Use .NET generic collection types rather than Python-style containers.

entries.meaning: Ordered, indexable dynamic array.
Map unique keys to values.
Store unique values with hashing.
A sequence you can enumerate; may be lazily computed.
Preserve static type information.

more.meaning: Read a missing key without exception.
Define equality / ordering explicitly where needed.

csharp.title: Delegates, lambdas & events
csharp.summary: Typed callbacks and C# events are not the same thing as Python callables.

entries.meaning: Delegate with a return value.
entries.detail: Func<int, int> square = n => n * n;

entries.meaning: Delegate that returns void.
Create an inline function.
Expose subscription/notification without allowing external invocation.
Attach or detach a handler.

more.meaning: Remove long-lived subscriptions when no longer needed.

csharp.title: LINQ sequences
csharp.summary: Sequence operators and deferred execution differ from Python comprehensions.

entries.meaning: Filter and project values.
Ask boolean questions without materializing results.
Return a first match or the type's default value.
Create an ordered sequence.
Materialize the result now.

more.meaning: Group by a key.
Many IEnumerable LINQ queries execute when enumerated.
more.detail: var query = items.Where(x => x.Ready); // not executed yet

csharp.title: Exceptions & disposal
csharp.summary: Preserve stack traces and release IDisposable resources deterministically.

entries.meaning: Handle only failures you can recover from.
Run cleanup after success or failure.
Preserve the original stack trace.
Dispose an IDisposable at end of containing scope.
Dispose IAsyncDisposable asynchronously.
entries.detail: await using var stream = new FileStream(path, FileMode.Open);

more.meaning: Catch only when a condition holds.

csharp.title: Tasks, async & cancellation
csharp.summary: Async waiting is not synonymous with CPU parallelism.

entries.meaning: Represents an eventual result.
Asynchronously wait for a task result.
Wait for multiple tasks; completion order may differ.
Propagate cancellation to supporting async APIs.
Control synchronization-context capture where relevant.

more.meaning: Reserve for event handlers; cannot be awaited normally.
more.detail: Prefer async Task for other methods

more.meaning: Use a bounded cancellation token or supported API timeout.

csharp.title: Runtime, GC & equality
csharp.summary: Know which semantics belong to the CLR and which are language contracts.

entries.meaning: GC reclaims eligible managed objects; it does not call Dispose for you.
Compare reference identity.
Value equality depends on the type's implementation.
Wrap a value-type value as object/interface, typically allocating.
Recover a boxed value with a compatible explicit cast.

more.meaning: string compares text contents with ordinal case-sensitive default equality.

csharp.title: Files, paths & JSON
csharp.summary: Use .NET APIs with explicit encoding, resource lifetimes and serialization contracts.

entries.meaning: Read small text files asynchronously.
Overwrite a text file asynchronously.
Combine path segments portably.
Produce JSON using System.Text.Json.
Read JSON into a known .NET type.

more.meaning: Ensure a directory exists.

csharp.title: Practical automation boundaries
csharp.summary: Reliable test automation separates language APIs, test assertions and external-system behavior.

entries.meaning: Always await operations that return tasks.
Bound external operations to avoid indefinitely hanging suites.
Prefer TryParse and explicit result checks for external data.
entries.detail: if (!int.TryParse(raw, out var port)) throw new FormatException();

entries.meaning: Dispose streams, responses and temporary resources deterministically.
Keep diagnostics with IDs, durations and expected/actual data.
entries.detail: Log correlationId, endpoint and status code

more.meaning: Do not share mutable fixture state unintentionally across parallel tests.
